difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a representable morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, quasi-compactness in the representable sense is equivalent to quasi-compactness of Z x_Y X for every quasi-compact algebraic space Z over Y (source lines 1212-1223). The first direction chooses a quasi-compact scheme U with a surjective etale U -> Z, observes that U x_Y X is a quasi-compact scheme by the representable sense of quasi-compactness, and concludes that Z x_Y X is quasi-compact because it receives a surjective etale morphism from U x_Y X. The second direction checks the definition of quasi-compactness of p : Z x_Y X -> Z on affine opens U of a scheme Z, where the preimage is U x_Y X and is quasi-compact by hypothesis.
